title: About Guidelark
description: Guidelark publishes plain-language guides to budgeting, saving, earning and paying off debt for students and people on small incomes.
body:
Most money advice assumes you have money left over at the end of the month. {{siteName}} is for the months when you don't.

## What you will find here

- **Budgeting** that starts from small and irregular incomes
- **Saving** methods that work with $10 at a time
- **Earning** ideas that cost nothing to start
- **Debt** payoff plans with the maths shown

Every article tries to do three things: use real numbers, say plainly when a popular rule doesn't fit, and end with something you can do this week.

## Who is behind it

{{siteName}} is an independent site run by one writer. I am not a licensed financial adviser, and nothing here is personal financial advice. I research each topic, show where figures come from, and update articles when the facts change.

## How articles are made

- Numbers in worked examples are calculated, not estimated, and the assumptions are stated.
- Prices and product details carry the date they were last checked.
- If an article ever contains an affiliate link or a sponsored mention, it will say so clearly at the top.
- Corrections are welcome. If you spot an error, [tell me](/contact/) and I will fix it.

## Get in touch

Questions, corrections and topic requests are welcome on the [contact page](/contact/).
